svg.title: How it works: source, collect, check, store, deliver
svg.desc: Animated pipeline: public job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) are collected with Python, checked with dbt tests and pytest, stored in DuckDB and Parquet, and delivered through GitHub. 1,500 job boards, about 9 minutes, once a day.
svg.text: 1,500 boards · about 9 min · once a day
